roles.drone.air_reso: sharpness of the drone's air bands (0 wide .. 1 as set by temperature)
roles.drone.air_tone: height of the drone's air bands (octaves)
roles.drone.brightness: spectral tilt and body cut-off of a drone
roles.drone.density: how full a drone is: partials and air
roles.drone.sparkle: how often a high harmonic rings out of a drone
roles.drone.width: stereo spread of a drone's partials
roles.drum.bass.glide: slide time of the melodic bass drum between held notes (s)
roles.env.release_switch: envelopes release with their decay time
roles.filter.character: filter character: vowel of a formant filter, drive of an scream filter
roles.filter.oversample: run the filter at 2x the sample rate
roles.filter.routing: two filters in series or parallel
roles.fm.op<n>.fixed_freq: operator n frequency in fixed mode (Hz)
roles.fm.op<n>.key_scaling: operator n level change per octave (dB)
roles.fm.op<n>.left_depth: level scaling depth below the break point
roles.fm.op<n>.mod<n>.amount: how much one operator modulates another (matrix cell)
roles.fm.op<n>.output: operator n output level (carrier loudness / modulator index)
roles.fm.osc_sync: operator phases restart on each note
roles.fx.delay.sync: delay time locked to a musical division
roles.fx.distortion.amount: distortion after the filter (0 clean .. 1 fuzz)
roles.fx.distortion.mode: distortion shaper: off, soft, tube, hard, fold
roles.fx.distortion.place: distortion before (pre) or after (post) the filter
roles.fx.flanger.delay: longest delay of the flanger sweep (ms)
roles.fx.flanger.depth: how far the flanger sweep goes
roles.lfo.amount: initial LFO depth (the mod wheel adds)
roles.lfo<n>.retrigger: LFO n restarts on each note
roles.macro<n>.cc: the MIDI CC that turns a macro
roles.map<n>.destination: the parameter a macro target moves
roles.map<n>.from: a macro target's value with its macro at 0
roles.map<n>.macro: the macro that drives a macro target
roles.map<n>.to: a macro target's value with its macro at 1
roles.master.limiter.ceiling: highest peak out of the master limiter (dBFS)
roles.master.limiter.mode: look-ahead peak limiter on the mix: off, on
roles.master.limiter.release: release time of the master limiter (s)
roles.master.saturation.mode: saturation on the whole mix: off, soft, tube, hard
roles.micro.attack_curve: shape of the attack: 0 linear, > 0 fast then slow, < 0 slow then fast
roles.micro.burst: tone burst length in cycles (0 = off)
roles.micro.click_mode: click on every hit: off, impulse, noise
roles.micro.decay_curve: shape of the decay and release (0 linear)
roles.micro.drive: saturation of the main sine, sub and click (dB)
roles.micro.env_mode: envelope behaviour: gate (note-off releases) or one_shot (runs to the end)
roles.micro.gate_depth: how far a closed step cuts the sound
roles.micro.gate_div: length of a step in sync mode
roles.micro.gate_hz: steps per second in free mode
roles.micro.gate_mode: 16-step gate pattern: off, on the beat, free running
roles.micro.gate_pattern: the pattern as 16 bits, step 1 = the lowest bit
roles.micro.hold: time held at full level after the attack
roles.micro.noise_decay: length of the noise's own decay (s)
roles.micro.noise_env: noise envelope: follow the amp, its own decay per hit, or per gate step
roles.micro.noise_filter: filter of the noise layer: off, lp, bp, hp
roles.micro.noise_gate: noise gating: off, same steps as the tone, inverse, own pattern
roles.micro.noise_pan: position of the noise relative to the pan
roles.micro.noise_rate: clock of the stepped and periodic noises (Hz)
roles.micro.noise_type: noise kind: white, stepped (sample and hold), periodic (7-bit shift register)
roles.micro.osc2_mode: second sine tuning: a ratio or an offset in Hz
roles.micro.osc2_offset: frequency offset of the second sine
roles.micro.osc2_pitch_env: the pitch envelope moves the second sine too
roles.micro.osc2_ratio: frequency ratio of the second sine
roles.micro.osc2_split: main sine left, second sine right
roles.micro.phase_reset: restart the sines at the start phase on every hit
roles.micro.pitch_curve: shape of the pitch envelope (0 linear)
roles.micro.pitch_mode: pitch from the key or a fixed frequency
roles.micro.ratchet_div: interval between the repeats on the tempo
roles.micro.ratchet_hz: repeat rate when not on the tempo
roles.micro.sub_octave: sub one or two octaves down
roles.mixer.feedback: output fed back into the mixer
roles.mlfo<n>.harmonic<n>.a: part LFO n Fourier shape: cosine coefficient of a harmonic
roles.mlfo<n>.harmonic<n>.b: part LFO n Fourier shape: sine coefficient of a harmonic
roles.mlfo<n>.retrigger: part LFO n restarts on a new phrase
roles.mod.slot<n>.via: modulation matrix slot n: scaling source
roles.mod.source: source routed by the mod wheel
roles.mod.source_a: first modulation source of a two-source mix
roles.mod.source_b: second modulation source of a two-source mix
roles.motion.detune<n>.depth: depth of the n-th per-voice detune modulation (cents)
roles.motion.detune<n>.rate: rate of the n-th slow per-voice detune modulation
roles.mseg<n>.point<n>.time: time to reach an MSEG point
roles.mseg<n>.sync: MSEG n times in seconds or beats
roles.network.amp_coupling: phase relations -> modulus coupling (cooperation or competition)
roles.network.drift: random walk of the partials' pitch
roles.network.drift_time: time scale of the random walk
roles.network.partials: number of partials in a network
roles.osc.unison.motion_rate: rate of the per-oscillator detune modulation
roles.osc<n>.position: position inside the wavetable (morphs between frames)
roles.osc<n>.sync: oscillator n hard-synced to the next one
roles.osc<n>.unison_detune: detune spread of the unison copies of oscillator n
roles.osc<n>.unison_voices: number of stacked detuned copies of oscillator n
roles.osc<n>.warp: phase warp amount of oscillator n
roles.osc<n>.warp_mode: phase warp type of oscillator n (sync, bend, mirror, fm, ring)
roles.output.crush.bits: resolution of the instrument's output (bits, 24 = clean)
roles.output.crush.rate: sample rate of the instrument's output (Hz, 48000 = clean)
roles.output.filter.cutoff: cutoff of the filter on the instrument's output (Hz)
roles.output.filter.mode: filter on the instrument's output: off, lp, hp, bp
roles.pad<n>.end: per-pad end point in the sample
roles.pad<n>.loop: per-pad loop between start and end
roles.pad<n>.start: per-pad start point in the sample
roles.part.fx_send: share of the part sent to the effect bus
roles.polymod.source_filter_env: poly-mod amount from the filter envelope
roles.resonator.tension: string nonlinearity: tension rises with the vibration (pitch glide)
roles.selfosc.drive: nonlinearity of the self-oscillator (sine to relaxation)
roles.selfosc.entrain: forcing of the oscillator by the note
roles.sub.route: the sub through the filter, or straight to the output
roles.tempo.clock: clock source: internal or MIDI clock
roles.tuning.a4: concert pitch: frequency of A4 in Hz
roles.tuning.degree<n>.offset: custom tuning offset of degree n
roles.tuning.root: note the tuning is built on
roles.vlfo.harmonic<n>.a: per-voice LFO Fourier shape: cosine coefficient of a harmonic
roles.vlfo.harmonic<n>.b: per-voice LFO Fourier shape: sine coefficient of a harmonic
roles.vmseg.sync: per-voice MSEG times in seconds or beats
roles.voice.drift: analog-style random pitch drift (standard deviation, cents)
roles.voice.drift_time: time constant of the analog drift (s)
roles.voice.jitter: analog phase jitter: white noise on the pitch (cents)
roles.voice.priority: which held key sounds on a monophonic voice (last / low / high)
roles.voice.tolerance: static per-oscillator offset of analog parts (cents)

conventions: Roles are unique within an engine. '<n>' stands for an index (osc1, osc2, motion.detune1...), '<instrument>' for a named note (drum.kick.level).
